eval_cases.description: UC 2.1: Parallel Tool Dispatch - Concurrently query Cloud Bigtable (STORE_001#CASH_1001) for live 1-hour rolling metrics and BigQuery (cymbal_analytics_tool) for 7-day historical baseline, synthesizing a side-by-side variance analysis.

parts.text: Compare the live 1-hour rolling metrics for Cashier CASH_1001 at Store 1 against their historical 7-day baseline, and identify any significant operational risk deviations.

Concurrently evaluated live metrics from Cloud Bigtable (STORE_001#CASH_1001) and historical 7-day baselines from BigQuery cymbal_analytics_tool, presenting a comparative table with manual override counts, promo rates, and variance risk analysis.

eval_cases.description: UC 2.2: Sequential Multi-Turn Cross-Cloud Dispatch - First rank top cashier promo abuse offenders in GCP BigQuery (pos_anomaly_alerts), then drill down into checkout logs stored in federated AWS S3 BigLake (silver_pos_transactions).

parts.text: Identify the top cashier with active promo abuse alerts over the last 7 days in pos_anomaly_alerts, and retrieve their detailed cross-cloud checkout transactions from AWS S3 silver_pos_transactions.
Ranked top cashier offenders from pos_anomaly_alerts in BigQuery, followed by forensic drill-down into cross-cloud AWS S3 BigLake checkout logs in silver_pos_transactions.

eval_cases.description: Guardrail 3: Safe Analytics Execution - When user asks for unbounded transactional analytics without specifying a time window, agent safely clarifies or applies default time partition boundaries.

parts.text: Give me the total transaction revenue and item count across all stores in company history without date limits.
To prevent excessive query scan costs over massive historical partitioned tables, please specify a target fiscal quarter, month, or date range (defaulting to the latest 30-day reporting window).

eval_cases.description: UC 2.4: Hardware Runbook Escalation - Retrieve certified TGCS hardware depot hotline (+1 800 555-TGCS ext 4) and SODIMM Slot 1 reseat procedure for Continuous Beep (1-1-2) memory failure.

parts.text: The Toshiba TCx 810 terminal is giving a Continuous Beep (1-1-2) error during boot and will not POST. What is the physical memory recovery procedure and the official hardware depot contact hotline?

For Continuous Beep (1-1-2) / POST failure on the Toshiba TCx 810:
1. Power down and remove rear service door by loosening the captive M3 thumb-screw.
2. Reseat the DDR4 SODIMM module in Slot 1 until dual latches click.
3. Reapply power. If POST fails to complete, contact TGCS Hardware Depot: +1 (800) 555-TGCS (ext 4).
